name: TravelSky Technology Limited
summary: TravelSky Technology Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides information technology (IT) solutions for the aviation and travel industries in the People's Republic of China. The company offers aviation information platform services comprising electronic travel distribution services, including inventory control and computer reservation systems; airport passenger processing system services; and information technology services. It also provides accounting, settlement, and clearing services, information system development and support services, and air travel financial services; distribution information technology services; and airport information technology services.
